title: Tales of Dorlune — final interface pieces
coordinate_convention: Rectangles [x0,y0,x1,y1], right/bottom exclusive. Pixel indices zero-based; centres use pixel-boundary coordinates. Caps are measured after trimming to bounds.
palette_provenance: 40 light/dark colour pairs measured from the approved supplied assets and contact sheet. No invented dark-mode colour mappings.
colour_count_definition: Distinct RGB values among fully opaque pixels; transparent pixels excluded.

proofs.phone_scale_display: Nominal point size at1point=1pixel; exact3xnearest-neighbour alongside.
